# United Mechanical

> 50+ years of comprehensive HVAC and commercial mechanical construction services across Oklahoma with design-build expertise and preventative maintenance programs.

United Mechanical operates through multiple service divisions including United Mechanical Construction (UMC), United Mechanical Service (UMS), and Donohue Commercial Service (DCS), serving Oklahoma City, Tulsa, and surrounding regions. The company specializes in commercial HVAC construction, repair, maintenance, and emergency services with a focus on energy efficiency and long-term client partnerships.

## Key Topics

- HVAC repair and maintenance
- Commercial construction
- Preventative maintenance programs
- Emergency services
- Design-build services

## Core Services

- [Commercial Mechanical Construction](https://www.unitedmech.com/solutions/commercial-mechanical-construction): Commercial HVAC construction, installation, and maintenance services in Oklahoma from United Mechanical.
- [HVAC Maintenance Solutions](https://www.unitedmech.com/solutions/maintenance): HVAC maintenance solutions in Oklahoma, Tulsa, and OKC with energy efficiency and emergency services.
- [HVAC Repair Services](https://www.unitedmech.com/solutions/repair): HVAC repair services in Oklahoma with 24/7 emergency support and performance guarantee.
- [United Mechanical Services Maintenance Program](https://www.unitedmech.com/about/ums): United Mechanical Services Proactive Preventative Maintenance Program with no extra repair costs.
